title: Joomla Extension - onlinecommunityhub.nl - Server-side request forgery via image check bypass in ochOpenGraph…
description: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability exists in the ochOpenGraph Joomla extension versions 1.0.0 through 3.1.0. The vulnerability allows bypassing the image check designed to prevent requests to internal addresses via redirects, internal IPv6 addresses, or remote image URLs containing the site address. This enables content authors to make the server send unauthorized requests to internal systems. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.1.
